source.name: UCI ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014
source.timestamp_rule: Source timestamps are interval endpoints; calendar assignment uses timestamp minus 15 minutes.
source.entities: 370 meter identifiers MT_001 through MT_370; entity is a data source, not buyer type or product quality.

products.alpha_mapping: alpha_q = 1 declared reference monetary unit * technical_score_q
products.rounding: decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN applied to retained audit CSV numeric text
products.rational_interpretation: The quantized decimal string is interpreted exactly; raw trace floating arithmetic is retained as provenance, not exact physical measurement.
products.quality_order: Delay order is fixed in advance; do not sort by measured score, smooth, merge or add epsilon.

pre_solver_rules: Complete reference and evaluation calendar windows on the verified 15-minute grid
All reference/evaluation source values finite, verified in official archive
Global first positive timestamp no later than end of reference month first day (first day + 1 day at 00:00); earlier activation remains valid even if first day has real zeros
All six quantized alpha values strictly positive and strictly increasing in prespecified delay order
eligibility.activation_rule_purpose: Remove inactive pre-activation zero padding before estimating reference scale; this is a data-validity rule fixed before solving.
eligibility.excluded_windows: Retain all original 2960 rows, all reasons, and original technical scores; none are hidden or relabelled.

selection.order: within each evaluation month, eligible windows sorted by selection_hash then client
selection.all_mode: All eligible windows using identical order and rules; no solver results consumed.

buyers.counts_semantics: Integer buyer counts within a declared simulation market; each permission group has 40, each theta level 30, total 120.
buyers.input_origin: Declared scenarios; not inferred from meter identifiers, electricity usage or posted prices.

cost_source.randomness: random.Random(profile_seed); for each product draw independent uniform(.95,1.05) multipliers for activation then service cost
cost_source.quantization: Original round(value,9), decimal string, exact Fraction; expected vectors stored below.
cost_source.origin: Scenario costs copied from original trace protocol; not measured operating expenditure.

alpha_q.source: UCI raw trace through declared normalized MAE score and 10-place quantization
alpha_q.calibration: Reference monetary scale fixed to one; no observed willingness-to-pay claim

c_q.source: Original paper reproducibility release seeded cost scenario

s_q.source: Original paper reproducibility release seeded cost scenario

n_k.source: Prespecified integer contingency matrices with fixed marginals

market_catalog_role: DaDaDa candidate product families motivate version design only; directory prices do not calibrate theta, n, permissions, or costs in protocol v1.
independence_note: Windows may share a source meter and adjacent reference periods; scenario combinations are paired instances, not independent observed markets.
execution_scope: Construct inputs and audit ledgers only; run no solver and infer no empirical performance claim.
